messages:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — customer asks keep coming for per-route + per-tenant cost breakdown tied to traces. Need concrete launch acceptance criteria.
Jake (Eng): +1. Biggest risk is tracing overhead and query perf on high-cardinality labels.
Sam (SRE): Concern: naive per-request traces will blow storage and ingest costs. We need sampling and aggregation.
Anya (Data): Customers want sliceable cost by model, route, and tenant; also want the link from cost line-items -> trace spans for debugging.
Maria (PM): Proposed acceptance (draft): 1) Dashboard shows cost by model+route for last 30d, 2) Traces show request_id and model metadata, 3) Sampling docs + deterministic sampling so debug-able examples surface.
Lukas (Design): UX ask: Add a top-level toggle to switch "show estimated cost" vs "raw usage" and a drilldown pane that highlights 95p latency + top error traces.
Jake (Eng): Implementation notes: we'll attach a minimal span with metadata: request_id, model_id, route, tokens_in, tokens_out. Use a compact header so it doesn't change hot path.
Sam (SRE): For sampling, propose tiered policy: always sample errors, sample 0.1% of successes by default, can bump to 1% for enterprise tenants.
Anya (Data): For attribution, we'll need deterministic keys to avoid double-counting. Suggest composite key = tenant_id|route|model_id when aggregating.
Maria (PM): Can we express sampling config as a small JSON policy we can surface in Console? Example: 
```
{
  "default_success_rate": 0.001,
  "enterprise_success_rate": 0.01,
  "always_sample_errors": true,
  "seed_key": "request_id"
}
```
Jake (Eng): That looks fine. Would prefer the seed to be hashed from request_id so it's uniform. Edge case: short lived requests with multiple retries — need to dedupe client-side.
Sam (SRE): We'll also add a low-overhead local counter to ensure we don't exceed ingest budget per host. Fallback if rate exceeded: drop non-error spans.
Lukas (Design): One more: in the drilldown, show estimated cost equation for a selected span: e.g., cost = tokens_in*model_rate_in + tokens_out*model_rate_out + infra-surcharge. Show assumptions.
Anya (Data): Data pipeline: write sampled spans to tracing index; emit aggregated rollups hourly to billing index. Rollups keys = tenant|route|model.
Maria (PM): Launch criteria checklist (proposal):
- UI: per-route per-model cost dashboard 30/7/90d available with drilldowns
- Tracing: sampled spans include request_id + model metadata, errors fully sampled
- Docs: sampling policy + how to interpret estimated cost
- Perf: end-to-end p50/p95 impact < 2% latency increase on hot path
- Cost: tracing ingest under controlled budget (configurable)
Jake (Eng): Feels actionable. Need spike to measure serialization cost of adding span metadata (today's KV header size ~32 bytes).
Sam (SRE): I'll run a canary with 0.1% perf-sampled traces in staging and report CPU/ingest delta.
Anya (Data): I'll map out rollup schema and show an example query for customer billing export.
Maria (PM): Ok plan: Jake spike + Sam canary + Anya rollup proto. If all green, we promote to alpha feature flag for a few enterprise customers.
DeployBot: Scheduled canary deploy at 2025-03-17T15:00:00Z for channel=staging, flag=trace-cost-alpha :rocket:
Jake (Eng): Quick Q: for per-tenant billing, do we want raw tokens or normalized tokens (model-specific multipliers)?
Maria (PM): Normalize to USD-equivalent using model_rate in the rollup step. Document assumptions.
Lukas (Design): I'll mock the drilldown panel and cost equation text by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (SRE): I'll collect staging metrics and post them here after the deploy.
Maria (PM): Great. Next sync Thurs 10am. Action owners: Jake (spike), Sam (canary + metrics), Anya (rollup schema), Lukas (mock). Thanks! :thumbsup:
